# opalstack_address (Data Source)

Looks up a mail address by `id` or by `source`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opalstack_address" "info" {
  source = "info@example.com"
}

output "info_mailboxes" {
  value = data.opalstack_address.info.mailuser_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) UUID of the address.
- `source` (String) The address itself, such as `info@example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `forwards` (Set of String) Addresses the mail is sent on to.
- `mailuser_ids` (Set of String) UUIDs of the mailboxes the mail is delivered to.
